entities.title: Rust workspace
entities.summary: The Cargo workspace of the four Rust tools (zazzled, agent-fs, fix-network and free-disk-space) and the three zazz crates zazzled uses for scripts: zazz-format, zazz-sdk and zazz-worker.
entities.purpose: Holds one crate per tool, the zazz crates, and what they share: the workspace's edition, minimum Rust version and license, the release profile (link-time optimization, stripped symbols, one codegen unit), one Cargo.lock, the formatting rules and style.md, the Rust rules for agents.
boundaries: The tools share settings, not code; only the zazz crates are shared: zazzled depends on zazz-format (the .zazz archive, manifest and script id) and zazz-sdk (the script protocol), and zazz-worker, a separate binary zazzled starts, depends on zazz-sdk. agent-fs, fix-network and free-disk-space depend on no other crate here.
zazz-worker embeds wasmtime and sets its own minimum Rust version (1.97); the rest of the workspace keeps the shared one (1.85).
Build output in target/ is never committed.
